canada.title: Flood watch in place on Vancouver Island as king tide impact continues
canada.summary: A flood watch is in place for eastern Vancouver Island as the B.C. coast continues to deal with a series of storms that are combining with unusually high tides on Thursday.

canada.title: Lloydminster drop-in centre still hunting for a home after development bid rejected
canada.summary: A proposed Lloydminster drop-in centre is still hunting for a home after its development application was rejected. The city says the application did not meet downtown redevelopment policies or land-use compatibility.

canada.title: Police identify suspect vehicle tied to midtown shooting, home invasion that killed Toronto musician
canada.summary: Toronto police have identified a suspect vehicle tied to a fatal shooting and attempted home invasion that took place early Wednesday in midtown Toronto.

canada.title: Aaron Rodgers’ distinguished career may have reached a bizarre, unceremonious end
canada.summary: Aaron Rodgers may not get to walk off the field to a standing ovation one final time to end his distinguished NFL career.

canada.title: B.C. Transit, union meet ahead of looming Greater Victoria transit strike
canada.summary: B.C. Transit and the union representing Greater Victoria transit workers will meet Thursday, ahead of a scheduled day-long strike that could shut down the region's transit system on Friday.

canada.title: Easier access to psilocybin therapy needed, patients and health experts say
canada.summary: Advocates in Saskatchewan spoke about their experiences with psychedelic therapy on Wednesday's Blue Sky.

canada.title: Sask. government introduces bill to 'protect infrastructure' against occupations, blockades
canada.summary: Saskatchewan introduced a bill Wednesday intended to protect economic infrastructure against "illegal occupations, disruptions and blockades."

canada.title: Students welcome plan to revive Aurora College social work program — but say it should be in Fort Smith
canada.summary: Haidyn Allingham and Austin Blanchard are both currently enrolled in a prerequisite diploma program in Fort Smith and now may have to move to Yellowknife next year if they want to continue pursuing social work degrees.

canada.title: Winnipeg neighbourhood group wants stronger enforcement of city's infill housing rules
canada.summary: A group of Winnipeg residents is calling for better infill design and more enforcement of the city's regulations. The Glenwood Neighbourhood Association says it's not opposed to infill, but wants it done properly.

canada.title: Why you might start seeing police officers at some LCBO outlets
canada.summary: The Liquor Control Board of Ontario is putting police officers in some locations across the province to target stores where booze bandits are running off with bags of expensive spirits.

canada.title: Alberta company proposes new Mackenzie Valley gas pipeline for the N.W.T.
canada.summary: The pipeline project is in its early stages and the company behind it is still actively looking for key partners. The company backing it hopes it will join the ranks of the territory's major projects referred to the MPO.

canada.title: A look inside N.B. Power’s nerve centre
canada.summary: The system operators of the energy control centre have to balance outages, both planned and unplanned, with the available power from generating assets and neighbouring electrical grids to provide homes and businesses with the power they need.

canada.title: Governor General to make first official visit to N.B. this week
canada.summary: During her first official visit to the province, Gov. Gen. Louise Arbour has plans to meet provincial officials and members of the Canadian Armed Forces in Fredericton and Base Gagetown.

canada.title: Why the large majority of new housing construction in Halifax is for the rental market
canada.summary: As of October, the large majority of housing starts in Halifax have been for units destined for the rental market. Experts say government incentives, planning policies and affordability are some reasons for this trend.

canada.title: Houston says website about informing the public, not a sign of looming N.S. election call
canada.summary: Premier Tim Houston says online advertisements and a website recently launched by the Progressive Conservatives are about helping people understand the challenges and opportunities facing the province, not a signal that an election call could be looming.

canada.title: Group so far unable to get green light for final section of Bonavista Peninsula ATV trail
canada.summary: An ATV trails group has the support of communities on the Bonavista Peninsula to develop the old railbed. However, the province has not granted them a four-to five kilometre section in an unincorporated community that would connect north and south sections of the network.

canada.title: Questions linger over proposed data centre in Sherbrooke, Que., after info session
canada.summary: Many Sherbrooke, Que., residents reported leaving an information session with lingering questions over the environmental and social impacts of the proposed AI data centre in the city's industrial park.

canada.title: After 18-year-old’s online exploitation and death, mom wonders why police didn’t search devices right away
canada.summary: An 18-year-old in St. John’s who died by suicide appeared to have been targeted for years by a global online child exploitation group yet police did not initially examine the teen’s phones and computers. Following an interview with CBC’s the fifth estate, the RCMP apologized to the family for not “properly” communicating “our offer/ability to further this investigation” and has since taken the devices for review.

Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade will also be a first: Organizers made an unprecedented decision to postpone the event to Saturday because of bad weather, The Associated Press reports.
An explosion and fire at a major oil facility in the Thai capital on Thursday injured at least seven people and forced nearby residents to evacuate, authorities said.
Ukraine drone attack kills five in Russian-occupied Zaporizhia, Al Jazeera reports.
